newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bank deposits rise 1.5 percent in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bank deposits rise 1.5 percent in Sept.

text.p: Venezuelan commercial bank deposits rose 58 billion bolivars ($123 million) in September, or 1.5 percent, to 3.978 trillion bolivars ($8.46 billion), Softline consultants reported.

According to the firm's monthly round-up of 38 commercial banks, 33.9 percent of total deposits were saving deposits, 38.8 percent in current accounts, and fixed-term savings accounted for 25 percent.

On the asset side of banks' balance sheets, total loan portfolios rose 56.3 billion bolivars, or 3.7 percent, to reach 1.583 trillion bolivars, while investments in securities reached 1.606 trillion bolivars.
Current loans accounted for 1.552 trillion bolivars of total loans, restructured loans 39.46 billion bolivars and contested loans 20.64 billion bolivars.
Provisions for bad loans stood at 179 billion bolivars at the end of September.
